title: retry after a local timeout stays on the local provider

checks.name: the retried step finally produced the scripted answer
the first local call was scripted to time out
a retry happened after the timeout
every attempt, including the retry, used the local provider
no attempt was made on the cloud mock provider
routing ran only once, so the retry could not re-route
no local-route lock violation was logged

notes: real headless run with a scripted TIMEOUT on the first call and a scripted ok on the second
llm-retry is the stock plugin in the profile; the second request is the retry
